title: Blood and Gold
game_overview: Manage a stable of pixel-art gladiators, upgrade their equipment, and dispatch them to tactical arena skirmishes for gold and renown.
winning_condition: Accumulate 5,000 Glory and defeat the Emperor's Vanguard in the Grand Coliseum.
losing_condition: All gladiators perish in battle and treasury falls below 50 gold with no recruits remaining.

controls.action: Select gladiator, open management panels, and trigger combat decisions.
Toggle the Battle Selection Board modal.
Toggle the Gladiator Equipment and Upgrade modal.
Pause or resume camp simulation time.
On-screen touch overlays to access Battle Board, Upgrades, and Roster on mobile devices.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Visual styling draws inspiration from minimalist top-down sci-fi tactical aesthetics: ultra-clean chunky pixel outlines, high-contrast flat color blocks, desaturated functional hulls/camp tiles paired with vivid alert accents (amber, crimson, teal), and crisp tactical HUD gauges reminiscent of a starship crew interface adapted into an ancient ludus command deck.
sections.summary: Tactical clean low-fi pixel art, crisp tactical readouts, and functional schematic aesthetics.
